description: We are a development team composed of developers who love Minecraft and are engaged in Minecraft-related development. privacy_intro:
Fluent Launcher (hereinafter referred to as the "Launcher") is a product provided by Xcube Studio (hereinafter referred to as "we").
This Privacy Policy explains how and why we collect, store, use, and disclose information about users ("you", "your") when you use our services or desktop application. By using our services, you acknowledge and agree to the practices described in this policy.
diagnostic_info_desc: Our application collects non-personally identifiable diagnostic data, such as crash reports and performance logs. This may include technical details about your device, such as its brand, model, operating system, and application version. Additionally, the Launcher may store log files containing diagnostic information on the user's device, which, by default, are not shared with us.
usage_data_desc: We use Microsoft services (such as Microsoft Partner Center) to collect usage data. To learn more about how Microsoft and its affiliates collect, use, and disclose data, please refer to Microsoft's Privacy Statement.
data_note: Please note that all collected information is anonymized and does not include any personal data. We do not share the collected information with any third parties.
issue_resolution_desc: We use aggregated information to diagnose and resolve any issues that may arise during the use of our application. This includes analyzing diagnostic data, such as crash reports and performance logs, to determine the root cause of the issues and develop solutions.
identify_usage_trends_desc: We use this information to identify and analyze trends in the usage of our services and applications. This includes analyzing aggregated usage data to understand how users interact with our services and measure usage intensity. We use this analysis to improve features, usability, and performance, and to inform future development decisions.
changes_to_policy_desc: We may periodically modify, update, or revise this Privacy Policy to reflect changes made to our application. When we make significant changes to this policy, we will notify you by updating the "Last Updated" date. You are responsible for reviewing this Privacy Policy regularly to stay informed about any updates. By continuing to use the services after this policy is modified, you accept the changes.
